items.statement: The two modeled enantiomer-specific C-H activation transition states have a defined free-energy separation.

expected.definition: G(TS20-b)-G(TS20-a) for the identical-composition Pd/L-pGlu/S C-H-activation models, mapped to the author a/b structures. Common-reference profile separation, not [G(TS20-b)-G(19-b)]-[G(TS20-a)-G(19-a)]. Common spectator species cancel exactly.
expected.conditions: SMD acetonitrile, thermal correction 363.15 K; full public S and L-pGlu. Use the same total charge, spin and particle/proton inventory in both TSs. The source does not explicitly state charge/multiplicity; neutral closed-shell Pd(II)/doubly deprotonated L-pGlu plus neutral S is a graph-based reconstruction, not a reported input. Declare and validate it.

items.statement: The isolated substrate has a configurational-inversion free-energy barrier at the stated substrate conditions.

expected.definition: G(S inversion saddle)-G(the connected isolated S/1b ground-state minimum), same neutral molecular formula and particle number, no Pd or ligand. Zero is the S minimum at its own conditions.
expected.conditions: SMD acetonitrile; 353.15 K; charge 0, singlet closed-shell reconstruction from the neutral graph. Source input charge/multiplicity was not explicitly printed.

items.statement: The isolated product has a configurational-inversion free-energy barrier at the stated product conditions.

expected.definition: G(P inversion saddle)-G(the connected isolated P/3ba ground-state minimum), same neutral E-alkenylated formula and particle number, no Pd or ligand. Zero is the P minimum at its own conditions.
